column1: # AQL Language Specification: Float special values (inf / -inf / nan)
# AQL exposes the IEEE-754 special values as lowercase reserved literals,
# following the true / false / none convention: `inf`, `-inf`, `nan`.
# They are parser-emitted Floats and render back to the same tokens, so
#   * cmp / tcmp / sort use a TOTAL order — NaN sorts after every other
#     value (greatest); -inf < finite < inf < nan. This is what the
#     collection words need (a non-total comparator silently corrupts
#   * lt / lte / gt / gte use IEEE *unordered* — any comparison involving
#     NaN is false. eq is false for NaN, neq is true.

column3: specials survive in a list, render canonically
